neighbours.label: ' be' / ' become' after a modal where 'required / needed / necessary' is coming next
fire: In severe cases, a blood transfusion may be required.
If the pain persists, further tests will be needed.
For larger groups, advance booking may be necessary.
Some patients find that a second operation may be required later.
A valid passport will be required at check-in.
If the swelling spreads, antibiotics might be needed.
Should it become necessary, staff will move you to another room.
For older models, an adapter may be required to connect the device.
quiet: In severe cases, the patient may be very tired for weeks.
If the pain persists, it will be worse in the morning.
For larger groups, the hall may be a little crowded.
Some patients find that the second operation was easier.
The flight will be delayed by about an hour tonight.
If the swelling spreads, the skin might look red and shiny.
Should it rain, the staff will move the party indoors.
For older models, the screen may be slightly dimmer.

notes: Card: ' be' 24 of top 32, ' may' 6; contexts 'a hospital stay may be needed', 'surgery may be required', 'should become necessary'; logit effect promotes necessary/required/need. The - pole is 'was/were [able]'.
